LESSON: LETTER SOUNDS AND LETTER NAMES-PHONICS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.1: Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are words letter names-Phonics the learner should be able to: (unique to the indigenous languages) formed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: LETTER SOUNDS AND LETTER NAMES-PHONICS
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics helps you succeed in LITERACY ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: LETTER SOUNDS AND LETTER NAMES-PHONICS
Study Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.)

What this means
In this part you learn to write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.). You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.).
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.). Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.))

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.).
3. Make one local Kenya example of Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are words letter names-Phonics the learner should be able to: (unique to the indigenous languages) formed?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Letter Sounds and letter names-Phonics means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: write upper and lower case  Learners sound diagraphs and words with 3 lessons letters correctly consonant clusters(ng, dh etc.).

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
